stable.title: DroidDeck 0.6.0
stable.summary:
> DroidDeck is 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No source withheld.
>
> DroidDeck is a community project in the truest sense. Because all of its code is public, the people who use it can read it, fix it and improve it, and in 0.6.0 you all sure did:
>
> 153 pull requests · 23 contributors · 10 first-timers · 73% of the pull requests came from the community.
>
> Thank you to everyone who sent code, translations, device testing and bug reports. Here’s everything we did together for this release:

preview.title: Fix Nova layouts and session drawer shortcuts
preview.summary: Improve Nova’s compact layouts with scrolling store tabs and build details, remove the redundant Updates heading, preserve full portrait artwork, and add drawer PiP and Select/Start shortcuts for Guide/QAM.

recentPreviews.title: Fix Nova layouts and session drawer shortcuts
recentPreviews.summary: Improve Nova’s compact layouts with scrolling store tabs and build details, remove the redundant Updates heading, preserve full portrait artwork, and add drawer PiP and Select/Start shortcuts for Guide/QAM.

recentPreviews.title: fix: shared logs carry Battle.net's and Blizzard's own logs
recentPreviews.summary: A Battle.net report on Discord (AYN Thor: "trouble launching the Battle.net Update Agent" when installing from desktop mode, then a black sign-in window after the email step) came with a log zip that had nothing from Battle.net itself: only gamescope and Proton start-up. Neither problem reproduces on a REDMAGIC tablet: a fresh install from desktop mode and from the Store page, on DroidDeck-Proton

recentPreviews.title: fix: correct Nova M1 and M2 mapping
recentPreviews.summary: The Retroid Pocket Nova's left M1 button appeared as Steam Deck R4, and its right M2 appeared as L4. Swap C/Z only for the Nova model with controller vendor 2022 and product 3001 (Retro) or 3002 (Modern/Xbox). Other models and controller IDs retain their existing mapping.

recentPreviews.title: fix: close the Stores and Library search with its X or Back
recentPreviews.summary: Once a search was typed in the Stores tab, there was no way to put the search box away: tapping outside or Back only hid the keyboard, and the box stayed until the text was deleted by hand.

recentPreviews.title: fix: Arabic text reads right to left when it mixes in English words
feat: a setting to keep Steam uncompressed while games run
fix: find GOG Galaxy SDK cloud saves when remote-config lists no locations
recentPreviews.summary: GOG games that use Galaxy SDK IStorage publish cloudStorage.enabled: true with an empty locations array. That is namespace default at %LocalAppData%/GOG.com/Galaxy/Applications/<clientId>/Storage/Shared/Files. DroidDeck treated the empty list as no cloud, so Manage saves showed "No cloud saves" even when the files were on cloudstorage.gog.com.

recentPreviews.title: fix: StarCraft starts its 32-bit client from Battle.net
recentPreviews.summary: StarCraft: Remastered crashes as soon as Battle.net starts it: its 64-bit client faults in ClientSdk.dll under FEX. The 32-bit client runs.

recentPreviews.title: fix(stores): let a game's description fill the free height of the page
recentPreviews.summary: On a store game's page, the description stopped at 150 dp and scrolled inside that box, even on a tall tablet with half the screen empty below it.

recentPreviews.title: fix: place GOG cloud saves at the location root
recentPreviews.summary: On a GOG game with cloud saves, DroidDeck logged a successful download but the game showed empty profiles. With Hollow Knight: Silksong the cloud files were written to .../Hollow Knight Silksong/default/saves/, while the game reads .../Hollow Knight Silksong/default/.

tests.title: Performance mode: unpaced buffer release, more swapchain images and cached per-frame window checks behind one switch
tests.summary: > Testers on the pr-1563 test build reported positive results. gamescope now comes from the official release gamescope-3.16.29-p13. The Wine fix (fix 4) follows with a DroidDeck-Proton release; until then Performance mode gives fixes 1-3.

tests.title: feat: profile PRoot costs and test fast-path libraries without an APK rebuild
tests.summary: Add opt-in PRoot handler CPU/wall profiling and one-session fast-path library overrides to shorten performance investigations and A/B testing; Android ARM64/Kotlin compilation and focused tests pass, with device validation pending.

tests.title: debugging tool for a possible native Linux application launch
tests.summary: this is not meant to be merged and is only a debugging tool to get certain logs that I need

tests.title: feat: pick a game's CPU cores in its game profile
Experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for the Linux runtime
tests.summary: This adds an experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for DroidDeck's Linux runtime. Steam, Proton and Linux apps can run on the phone's own Adreno Vulkan driver (or an imported AdrenoTools driver) instead of Turnip. Proton games, the Steam client and Zink-based OpenGL all present through it. The phone's system graphics stack is not modified and nothing needs root.

tests.title: feat: add experimental Android XR tracking and SteamVR support
tests.summary: Experimental Android XR support. Physical Galaxy XR tracking, controller input, haptics, and SteamVR gameplay remain unverified. Successful compilation or emulator UI testing does not establish end-to-end headset support.

tests.title: feat(stores): download Amazon engine on demand
tests.summary: Pilot one optional store engine before expanding the model. Amazon downloads its own Android ARM64 native engine through the existing APK-pinned add-on pack infrastructure. GOG/Epic remain bundled. No account format, sidecar, installed-game path or download-queue migration.

tests.title: Add opt-in Pixel WoW64 and D3D9 compatibility tools
tests.summary: American Nightmare (Steam 202750) on the tested Pixel PowerVR/WoW64 setup first stopped because device-backed GPU allocations mapped above 4 GiB could not be represented by Wine's 32-bit bridge. After that was addressed, the 3D scene showed bright dotted triangle edges over textured geometry. This submits the reviewed, opt-in low32 and D3D9 single-sample workarounds directly to official DroidDeck,

tests.title: Retain compositor resources when GPU completion is unconfirmed
tests.summary: Finite fence waits can fail while submitted GPU work is still pending. Continuing or tearing down after that result can reset resources still in use or free image memory before completion. This adds a terminal completion-unknown state that stops further presentation and retains pending resources until the app process exits, while preserving the existing genuine-device-loss path.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: fix: Steam's first frame no longer waits on the client re-downloading itself
tests.summary: The install used to take whichever of Valve's three official client-update hosts answered the manifest first, and that is rarely the fastest one. It now measures all three by fetching the head of the largest component from each, keeps the fastest, and prints the host and the rate it measured, so the log says which one it used.

tests.title: feat: detailed adds startup step times and game logs, and the diagnostics page has a log level
tests.summary:
The diagnostics page now has a log level under "Session logs", shown only while session
logs are on. Standard is what ships today. Detailed adds:

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.
